featured_reviews.name: Swapnil A.
featured_reviews.review_text: Discovered this fun place for kids recently and surprisingly I ended up enjoying it as much as the kids. I was here at my nephews birthday party so I imagined this to be only for kids but I was glad to find out that adults can use almost the entire play area too. Theres a trampoline zone, ball pit, slides, arcade games and so much more that we ended up playing as much as the kids. It just brings out the child inside you. And no doubt the kids had a blast till the place was shut. Do take ur kids and enjoy with them!

featured_reviews.name: Pooja Surve
featured_reviews.review_text:
Thank you Bachha Party for such a wonderful birthday celebration! 🎉 The play area was super fun and safe, the food was delicious, and the kids had an amazing time. The decorations and music created such a lovely party vibe, and the tattoo artist was a big hit with the children! Everything was well-organized and stress-free for parents.
Special thank you to Tejashree and Manoj for helping me out with the planning, you guys were very supportive.

featured_reviews.name: Priyanka Parkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Thank you Bacha Party for organising my son's birthday so well. The decoration was lovely, food was tasty and good and kids as well as adults enjoyed the indoor play area a lot! Thank you once again......

featured_reviews.name: Tejaswini
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently celebrated my daughter’s birthday at Bachcha Party, and the experience was absolutely wonderful. Everything from the play area itself to the décor, food, and overall arrangements was perfectly done and truly exceeded our expectations.

A special mention to Dikshita and Archi, who helped us plan the entire celebration. They were extremely cooperative, attentive, and ensured that everything ran smoothly. Their effort and support made the whole experience stress-free and enjoyable for us.

The food quality was excellent, the setup looked lovely, and the kids had an amazing time. I would highly recommend Bachcha Party to anyone looking to host a fun and well-organized celebration for their little ones.

Thank you for making my daughter’s birthday so special! 🎉

featured_reviews.name: Pushpa G
featured_reviews.review_text:
Thank u so much baccha party matunga me n my family n relatives were so pleased with ur service n they way u guys hosted my son's birthday party. It was best decision ever to I did for my son's birthday.
Impressed with your staff n way they were serving us ..
Thank u so much.....

featured_reviews.name: samiksha devrukhkar
featured_reviews.review_text: I organised my daughter’s 5th birthday party just today with full occupancy and trust me it was the best decision ever. My daughter frequently visits Baccha Party Matunga to play n enjoy and so she wanted to celebrate her bday there. Whole staff is very polite and kind especially Ms.Pallavi. She was very humble and helpful and always available to clear your doubts. She helped me with package for food and everything in a way that it fits my budget. Thank you to all the staff members and it’s definitely worth very single penny. Definitely recommend everyone to visit
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you so much for your kind words and positive review. It means a lot to know you had a great experience.

featured_reviews.name: neha varhadi
featured_reviews.review_text: The play area is huge and has many activities for the kids to easily spend 3 hrs or so without getting bored. The staff was helpful and courteous. Food was tasty and the staff  made sure to modify as per our demands . In all we have a good time celebrating my kids birthday there.

featured_reviews.name: Sonali Hegishte
featured_reviews.review_text: A big shout out for Baccha Party Matunga, for hosting such a fabulous party on my daughter's Birthday.. Everyone including adults enjoyed & had a blast.. The staff were cooperative and just took the lead with everything.. all kids loved the activities, slides and the game arcade.. It was so lovely to be able to just relax and watch them have so much fun.. coming to the food, taste n the quantity was spot on, never had to ask or wait for anything.. in short, The party was a hit! And we all had an amazing time!! Thank you so much for everything 🙏

featured_reviews.name: Saniya Sayed
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently celebrated my brother's birthday party at this venue, and I must say it was an outstanding experience! The team was truly amazing—each member displayed a remarkable level of calmness and respect, which was especially impressive given that we were a lively group of boys. Their ability to manage everything seamlessly made it easy to trust them completely. My brother and his friends had an absolute blast, thanks to the fantastic service and delicious food that exceeded our expectations. It felt like we could take a break and leave everything in their capable hands, ensuring the party was unforgettable.

I would also like to extend a heartfelt thank you to Mr. Bipin for being such a great coordinator throughout the event. Additionally, the team ensured that even my 2-year-old niece felt included and cherished during the celebrations, which was a wonderful touch. Overall, it was a memorable day filled with joy and laughter!

Whether you’re going with friends, family, or coworkers, it’s a great place to test your teamwork and problem-solving skills while having a lot of fun. Everything was well organized, and the attention to detail in the room design was impressive.

Highly recommend Neon Splash for anyone looking for a unique and memorable escape room adventure. Can’t wait to come back and try another room! 🔐

featured_reviews.name: SAHIL RATNAPARKHI
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited FunTime Carnival and overall it was a really great experience. It’s an all-year-round carnival with a good variety of rides, each priced differently — ₹100, ₹200, or ₹300 per person.
The entry ticket is ₹100 per head, and that ticket can be used for any ride of the same cost, which is a nice and flexible system.
We had a great time — bumper cars, kids’ play area, and the zip-line adventure zone were definite highlights. We visited in the second week after opening, so some rides were still being installed and work was ongoing, which is understandable.

One major downside was the Arcade zone inside. It consists of machine games and prize-winning games. Entry is ₹200 per person, and you get three attempts at each of the five games. However, you only get a prize if you win all five games, which is practically impossible since a few games are quite tricky.
The prize is just a small (~30 cm) stuffed toy, which is not worth the price. Bigger toys are displayed but cannot be won. This wasn’t clearly explained beforehand — otherwise, we wouldn’t have played at all. I’d strongly suggest skipping the Arcade section.
Another drawback was the food, which felt way too expensive for what was offered.

Despite these two points, we had a great time overall and would definitely visit again, mainly for the rides and overall carnival vibe.

featured_reviews.name: Kaustubh Kushte
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited FunTime Borivali near Yogi Nagar recently.

Location: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (5/5) – Very convenient and easy to reach.
Pricing: ⭐⭐⭐☆☆ (3/5) – Entry is ₹100 per person and redeemable, but the overall experience doesn’t fully justify the effort required.
Food: Not tried – they have a tie-up with Borivali Gossip Corner for catering.

Some games were not functional (hammer game), and the token system is poorly designed. For every game, you need to go back to the entrance counter to collect tokens, which becomes tiring and confusing. The counter staff also seemed unsure at times.

The soft play area (₹300 for 30 minutes) was good and kids enjoyed it, but a major concern was that kids were released without being handed over to parents, which is a safety red flag.

Overall, the attempt is good, but there is a lot of scope for improvement in operations, staff training, maintenance, and safety processes.
